deployment_blockers: Provision an independent erp_calculator password in the deployment secret store; never embed it in migrations or expose it to browser/API/MCP clients.
Configure a calculator-only database connection whose session_user is erp_calculator; the standard erp_runtime connection cannot issue artifacts.
Execute the PostgreSQL 15 rollback fixture and end-to-end issue/consume/replay/concurrency tests before enabling calculation-bound posting.

private_boundary.required_caller: reviewed SECURITY DEFINER typed posting command
private_boundary.transactional_behavior: row and aggregate locks plus consumption update roll back with posting failure

proof.canonical_payload_owner: versioned application Decimal engine and serializer
proof.database_role: bind exact bytes and metadata; validate typed aggregate/idempotency/command; consume once

schemas.canonicalization: RFC 8785 JCS object-key ordering; every decimal value remains its normalized JSON string from the Decimal engine
